basics.name: Florian Bojda
basics.label: Technical Lead @ 360Learning (former eLamp CTO)
basics.summary:
Dad of two boys, runner, and hands-on tech leader.
I’ve spent the last decade building software and supporting engineering teams, first as co-founder at eLamp, and now as Tech Lead at 360Learning post-acquisition.
I focus on supporting developers, solving tricky platform challenges, and building practical enterprise AI solutions.

work.name: 360Learning
work.summary:
Following eLamp's acquisition, I took ownership of the Skills product engineering domain as a squad Tech Lead.
Responsible for leading team growth, driving cross-squad technical strategy, and unifying two distinct software architectures into a single cohesive SaaS platform.
highlights: 👥 Built, mentored, and led a high-performing squad of 5 experienced senior developers on the Skills domain, establishing engineering best practices and technical roadmap ownership.
🏛️ Architected the deep integration between the eLamp Skills engine and the core 360Learning platform, resolving intricate multi-tenant, data-consistency, and state-synchronization challenges.
🕸️ Overcame major technical hurdles in aligning disparate data models, merging real-time skills taxonomy engines with 360Learning’s architecture.
🔄 Designed integration pipelines to synchronize enterprise client skills data across both platforms.
🤝 Fostered technical collaboration between the Skills team and core platform squads to streamline cross-system dependencies.

work.name: eLamp
work.summary:
Co-founded and scaled an enterprise AI SaaS platform providing Strategic Workforce Planning to tier-1 industrial clients (Naval Group, Bouygues). Built the R&D and engineering teams.

The platform enabled clients to quickly identify internal talent, manage critical compliance certifications, and map long-term workforce capabilities for upcoming projects.
Using AI, Knowledge Graphs, and semantic search, eLamp automated the mapping of employee skills to complex project requirements, reducing time-to-staffing and preventing costly operational skill shortages
highlights: 👥 Co-founded the platform, grew the R&D and engineering teams, and established the technology vision leading to successful acquisition.

🤖 Designed and implemented proprietary fine-tuned ML transformer models and Knowledge Graph architectures for automated skills mapping and RAG-based intelligence. Trained and fine-tuned transformer models to perform vector-based semantic search and knowledge retrieval on domain-specific data. Trained a few-shot model to classify skills and enrich enterprise skills mapping
🧠 Transformed experimental AI models into reliable web features in production.

🛠️ Architected the platform as microservices to support core functionalities, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and high availability. Defined services boundaries, interactions between domains, and infrastructure components supporting sync/async communication patterns.
☸️ Engineered cloud-native infrastructure on Kubernetes, establishing automated deployments through CI/CD pipelines, and real-time operational monitoring through OpenTelemetry
🔒 Built enterprise-grade security and scalable infrastructure serving tier-1 industrial clients (e.g., Bouygues Construction, Naval Group, Artelia).
